facts.value: With a nonnull cursor, decrements a nonzero command timer. While cursor exists and timer is zero, offers every opcode to Command_Execute first. If declined, opcodes below 0x15 dispatch via table index opcode-0xA without a local lower-bound check; others invoke the owner callback without a null check. A true local-handler result returns immediately before blending or lifetime decrement. Otherwise enabled floating RGBA tracks add deltas and cast to bytes without clamping, even with a null cursor. Decrements any nonzero x4_pri and returns true only if that decrement reaches zero; otherwise false.
